description: A safety officer must authorize the controlled reopening of a warehouse dock after a powered industrial truck battery overheated during charging, finalizing the battery quarantine, pallet relocation, charger shutdown, fire-watch, and operator assignment controls.

shared_context.S1: Forklift battery B-14 overheated while charging at Dock 2, producing smoke but no visible flame.
shared_context.S2: Dock 2 is closed pending Nora's authorization; in this meeting's settlement, dock_reopened=true means Nora authorizes a controlled reopening contingent on the stated controls and commitments, not that the physical reopening has already occurred.
shared_context.S3: The warehouse must continue processing outbound orders from the other docks during the review.
shared_context.S4: The site's incident routine requires Nora to call on maintenance, warehouse logistics, fire protection, and training and staffing one at a time, receive a formal reveal of each person's incident findings, and confirm all four updates before issuing the authorization; Nora does not settle before every department has completed its update.

PF1.text: Elias's inspection found internal cell damage in battery B-14; it must be removed from the charger and isolated in the steel battery cabinet for exactly 24 hours before any disposition. He recorded the inspection in the maintenance log, but the incident channel has not yet been updated.

PF2.text: Mei's dock inventory check found exactly 18 outbound pallets currently blocking the safe access route at Dock 2; they must be moved to staging lane S-4 before reopening. She confirmed the lane assignment on the floor map, but dispatch has not yet updated its board.

PF3.text: Caleb's thermal scan found heat damage at charger C-12 on the same circuit as the incident; C-12 must be de-energized for exactly 6 hours, with a fire watch maintained for exactly 4 hours after the dock is reopened. He completed the scan during the response, but the fire-protection log is not yet signed.

PF4.text: Priya's certification review found that the scheduled night forklift operator, Tom, lacks the current battery-emergency training; Elena is the only currently qualified substitute for the night shift. Priya completed the review for tonight's roster, but the staffing board still shows Tom.

acceptance_conditions: Dock 2 must be authorized to reopen after the controls are completed.
Battery B-14 must be removed and isolated for exactly 24 hours.
Exactly 18 pallets must be relocated to staging lane S-4.
Charger C-12 must be de-energized for exactly 6 hours.
A fire watch must be maintained for exactly 4 hours after reopening.
Elena must replace Tom as the night forklift operator.
Night-shift training status must be explicitly verified.
The battery cell-damage finding must be cited in the justification.

decisive_facts.why: The internal cell-damage finding changes the battery decision from an unspecified hold to removal and exactly 24 hours of steel-cabinet isolation, and it supplies the required cited justification.
The dock inventory check changes the reopening plan to relocation of exactly 18 pallets to the specific S-4 staging lane.
The thermal scan changes the electrical response to a 6-hour C-12 shutdown and fixes the post-reopening fire watch at exactly 4 hours.
The certification review changes the night assignment from Tom to the specifically qualified substitute Elena and requires explicit training verification.
